definitions.explanation: Any substance or device capable of producing a violent explosion, including bombs, grenades, and industrial blasting agents.

⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{固|かた}く→固い：12090_katai⟧⟦{禁|きん}じられている→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧ (explosion) + ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ (thing, object). Common in legal, police, and security contexts.
